integrity: Derived from analytic radial envelope comparisons and independently rechecked using the packaged standard-library test; no independent audit or external certification performed.
scientific_limitations: One-step model stability indices only; convex nondecreasing radial zero-floor functions and test radii with positive differentiable profile; the square root must be convex or concave along the radial segment. No claim on general nonradial objectives, globally valid NGN lower models, stochastic expected convergence, or superiority of actual objective decreases. Unindexed equivalent mathematics remains possible.
title: Square-root curvature orders proximal and Gauss–Newton stability on radial losses
